subject: Intl Dev Bootcamp — budget, local tax & PO path
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@brightspark.co, Sandra Lopez <sandra@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Intl Dev Bootcamp — budget, local tax & PO path

Hi Laura / Markus,

Quick note to start the procurement flow for the "International Developer Bootcamp" we confirmed for mid-October (BrightSpark running on-site + virtual streaming). BrightSpark sent an initial SOW and a draft invoice — attaching budget breakdown and SOW (RB-bootcamp-budget-breakdown-aug2026.xlsx, SOW_BrightSpark.pdf).

Key asks:
- We need a purchase order or P-card path to cover the venue + streaming + local coordinator (~€48,200 total).
- BrightSpark is EU-registered and will invoice with VAT. We need to confirm how Redwood handles VAT recovery / VAT-inclusive PO vs. grossed-up reimbursements.
- There are small speaker honoraria (6x €500) — prefer vendor to pay and invoice us; might need a per-person stipend cap on PO or separate honorarium line.
- Also flagging potential withholding requirement for honoraria in Spain/Portugal depending on speaker status — vendor asked if Redwood can provide W-8/W-9 equivalents or a statement.

Budget snapshot (detailed in attached):
- Venue + AV + staffing: €30,000
- Streaming infra and encoding: €8,200
- Local logistics & permits: €5,000
- Speaker hospitality & honoraria: €3,000
- Contingency (5%): €2,000

Can you advise the correct cost-center coding and whether we should issue a PO (preferred by vendor) or use a P-card? If a PO, please confirm the GL/cost center and any tax notes we should pass to BrightSpark (VAT reclaim guidance or invoice language). Also let me know if finance needs the vendor W-8/W-9 equivalent or any other compliance docs.

Goal: get PO or approved P-card exception by EOD Monday so vendor can lock the venue.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 15 to walk through if helpful.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Sr. Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: RB-bootcamp-budget-breakdown-aug2026.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW_BrightSpark.pdf (contract)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 12:36:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Intl Dev Bootcamp — budget, local tax & PO path

Tessa — thanks for the clear breakdown. A few items from finance/procurement:

1) PO vs P-card: BrightSpark prefers a PO. Standard policy is PO for >€10k. We can issue a PO, but need: vendor legal name, VAT number, billing address, and confirmation whether invoice will be VAT-inclusive. If BrightSpark will provide a VAT invoice, we can request VAT recovery but need to route through AP with the VAT number.

2) Cost center / GL: Use cost center 430-DEV-MKT-EU and GL 6201 (Events & Sponsorships). If you want honoraria broken out, create a separate line item with GL 6512 (Speakers / Honoraria) so we can track tax treatment separately.

3) Withholding: If honoraria are paid through BrightSpark, they should handle local withholding. If Redwood pays individuals directly (unlikely here), we'd need local tax forms or contractor agreements. Request BrightSpark confirm whether they will gross-up or remit withholding.

4) Compliance docs: We need BrightSpark's W-9 / EU VAT certificate on file (PDF) and a copy of their bank routing for SEPA transfers. If they are not EU VAT-registered, AP will need a reason for non-registration.

If you can provide vendor VAT number and the SOW with the billing/legal entity, procurement can generate a PO (lead time ~48 hours). If you require a P-card exception (preferred for smaller vendors), include justification and the approver (Markus).

Also adding procurement@redwood.com to keep the pipeline visible.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Finance Manager — Accounts Payable
Redwood Inference

---

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 17:05:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Intl Dev Bootcamp — budget, local tax & PO path

Thanks — I authorize moving forward with a PO for BrightSpark for the amounts listed, with the following constraints:

- Approved spend cap: EUR 50,000 total (including contingency).
- Honoraria: cap €500 per speaker (6 speakers) — include a discrete line item so tax treatment is visible.
- Cost center/GL: use cost center 430-DEV-MKT-EU and GL 6201 for venue/streaming; GL 6512 for honoraria as Laura suggested.
- P-card exception: approved only for incremental small expenses (<€1,000) after PO issuance. Any advance >€5,000 must be on PO.

Markus authorizes procurement to create PO EV-2026-042 and route to BrightSpark. Procurement: please include the following payment terms on the PO: Net 30, payable via SEPA transfer in EUR; vendor must attach VAT invoice and provide VAT number on invoice. If vendor requests payment before services, routing through a reserve or deposit under PO EV-2026-042 is okay up to €15,000, but needs a 2nd sign-off from me.

Tessa — for your ask about W-8/W-9 equivalents: since vendor is EU-registered, they need an EU VAT certificate. If BrightSpark engages subcontractors for honoraria they should provide their own tax docs.

I'll approve the PO and the contingency. Procurement — please draft PO EV-2026-042 and send to BrightSpark; include the GL/cost center noted above.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Field Marketing (EMEA)
Redwood Inference

---

From: BrightSpark Events <ops@brightspark.co>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 02:08:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Intl Dev Bootcamp — budget, local tax & PO path

Hi Tessa / Markus / Laura,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the clarity on PO preferences. Confirming the following from our side:

- Legal name: BrightSpark Events Ltd.
- VAT: GB987654321 (we will provide VAT invoice for EU VAT-registered buyers).
- Billing address: 12 Old Mill Lane, Lisbon, Portugal 1100-123
- Payment: SEPA transfer (EUR); bank details attached in vendor_invoice_stub.pdf.

We can accept PO EV-2026-042 — please send when ready. We will include a separate line for honoraria (6 x €500) and mark it as taxable/subject-to-withholding if required by local law. BrightSpark will handle local withholding for any subcontracted speakers and will provide certificates on request.

Attached: vendor_invoice_stub.pdf (invoice draft). We will also upload VAT certificate and bank mandate to the DocuSign envelope you shared once PO is issued.

Best regards,
Ana Sousa
Operations Manager
BrightSpark Events
ops@brightspark.co
